entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • 'GenerateConstructorCodeFixProvider' encountered an error and has been disabled #82157
  • Analyzer suggestion: warn when calling Substring on nullable string in Blazor components #82150
  • Keep Obsolete ITypeSymbol extension APIs #82148
    18.5

Closed

  • Severe SemanticModel performance regression with Roslyn 5.0 vs 4.14 - 4x slower #81815
    18.4
  • Hot Reload: Handle projects with CodePage property #81930

PullRequests

Created

  • MSBuildWorkspace: Load projects for languages that do not have a known command line parser #82159
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Rename - fix rename conflicts not displaying in UI #82158
    Area-IDE
  • Update SQLitePCLRaw to 2.1.6 and remove NETSDK1206 suppressions #82156
  • [18.4] Add support for labeling Find results as comments or strings #82155
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Convert language server project into .NET tool #82154
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [release/dev18.3] Extensions: Optimize GetExtensionMembers #82153
  • Backflow VMR locally to unblock Maestro flow #82151
    VSCode
  • Normalize mapped paths in MapSourceRoots task #82149
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Extensions: Optimize GetExtensionMembers #82124
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • [EnC] Use default encoding stored in the PDB for creating committed document SourceText #81912
    Area-Compilers, Area-Interactive, VSCode, Next
  • Fix NuGet package search by restoring fallback #82129
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Unsafe evolution: handle remaining member kinds #82043

Updated

  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 2888239 #82117
    Area-Compilers
  • MakeFinalIVTDetermination: Cache AssemblyIdentity instead of AssemblySymbol #82132
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce allocations during analysis result creation. #82139
    Area-Analyzers
  • Refactor attribute filtering in PE symbols #82118
    Area-Compilers
  • Cleanup server capabilities providers and delete unused LSP providers #82116
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Support marking generated public APIs as experimental #82131
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • [BuildHost] Move RPC contracts to a separate assembly #81643
    Area-IDE, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Add more details to stale project update warning #82053
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Improve elimination of redundant evaluations during pattern matching operation #82142
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Pattern Matching
  • [WIP] Consolidate ExternalAccess libraries #81593
    Area-IDE, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Validate generator diagnostics after incremental updates #82113
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix a crash involving `[SetsRequiredMembers]` and required property using field keyword on a base type #82136
    Area-Compilers
